title: AI Picker Consumes Normalized Evidence Graph for Decision Context
goal: Replace the picker's flat findings + tested_keys + task_outcomes context with a compact projection of the normalized evidence graph so the AI sees first-class entities and relationships when choosing the next action, enabling cross-runner pivoting and cross-target chains.
scope: Modify api/app/services/assessment_loop.py _claude_select_next_action user_content construction to project the normalized graph into a token-efficient representation. Add a graph-summarizer service that emits the projection. Keep existing fallback for runs without graph data.
generation_reason: Without graph-aware context, the AI cannot reason about chains across target types (web finding -> internal hostname -> port scan -> AD pivot). Today the picker only sees flat 1-line strings per finding. The graph already exists; bridging picker consumption is the cheapest unlock for cross-target reasoning.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Picker context projection only. Do NOT change the system prompt structure, exec_plan grammar, or memory tool behavior.
constraints.token_budget: Projection must stay under 4 KB on typical runs to preserve prompt caching benefit. Larger graphs should be summarized, not dumped verbatim.

success_criteria: New graph projection function exists, callable from the picker, emits compact text suitable for an LLM prompt.
_claude_select_next_action prefers the graph projection over flat lists when both are available.
Token cost per picker hop remains within 10% of pre-change baseline (measured via the existing usage log line).
Tests prove the projection handles empty graphs (early phase) and >50-entity graphs (late phase) without overflow.
Existing picker behavior under runs without graph data is unchanged (regression test).

acceptance_criteria: Picker advance log shows graph-context lines when graph entities exist.
Token usage per hop stays bounded by graph size (no unbounded growth).

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
backlog-372 ingestion helpers must be merged.

out_of_scope: Changes to the runner-side ingestion helper API.
